title: conchophyllum philippinense
intro: Conchophyllum philippinense, commonly known as the Philippine conchophyllum or mountain conch, is a plant species that belongs to the family Cephalotaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of C. philippinense include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce inflammation, lower body temperature, and relieve coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
